title: Quantum Computing Breakthrough
description: New stable qubits developed for scalable quantum processors.

content.text: Researchers have achieved a major milestone in quantum error correction, paving the way for fault-tolerant quantum computers.

content.label: Key Finding
content.text: The new method reduces qubit decoherence by 40% using a topological approach.

content.label: Impact
content.text: This could accelerate drug discovery and materials science by decades.

title: AI Regulations in 2026
description: Global summit establishes new safety standards for AGI development.

content.text: The Global AI Safety Summit has released a comprehensive framework for monitoring advanced AI systems.

content.label: The Framework
content.text: Mandatory third-party auditing for models exceeding 10^26 FLOPs.

content.label: Timeline
content.text: Implementation begins Q1 2027 across G20 nations.
